title: 7827 Solomon Aron Jacob Vitenson, Alexander Pavlovich Berlinsky

page_data.en:
REGISTER
D. 2827

March 10 37.

Commissioner of Police,
Macao.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter No. 145, dated February 3, 1937, in regard to (1)
Solomon Aron Jacob Vitenson and (2) Alexander Pavlovich
Berlinsky, and in reply to inform you that Vitenson, a
Lithuanian Jew, born on December 15, 1882, at Kovno, arrived
in Shanghai from Harbin in 1919 and was employed as a
salesman in a haberdashery store until 1921 when he left for
Vladivostock and Harbin. He returned to Shanghai in 1926
and established the "Ideal" Haberdashery Store, 835 Avenue
Joffre, where he still carries on business. He is in
possession of a Lithuanian passport, No. 224 issued at
Vladivostock in 1921.

A.P. Berlinsky, Russian Jew, born on September 16,
1896, at Irkutsk, Siberia, came to Shanghai from Harbin in
August, 1929 and opened a small watch repairing and jewellery
store at 807 Avenue Joffre. In 1934, he expanded his business
having obtained financial assistance from two Spanish partners
and established the "Ural" Jewellery Store, 987 Avenue Joffre.
On June 26, 1936, Berlinsky was fined $50 by the French
Police for receiving stolen property. He is registered with
the local Russian Emigrants' Committee.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. **〔此处转录不清〕**

D. 2827

1937年3月10日。

致：
澳门警务处处长。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1937年2月3日第145号来函，内容涉及 (1) 所罗门·阿伦·雅各布·维滕森（Solomon Aron Jacob Vitenson）和 (2) 亚历山大·帕夫洛维奇·伯林斯基（Alexander Pavlovich Berlinsky）。现复函告知：维滕森系立陶宛犹太人，1882年12月15日生于科夫诺（Kovno），于1919年从哈尔滨抵达上海，并在一家服饰用品店担任售货员，直至1921年前往符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）和哈尔滨。他于1926年返回上海，并在霞飞路835号创办了“理想”（Ideal）服饰用品店，目前仍在该处经营。他持有1921年在符拉迪沃斯托克签发的立陶宛护照，号码为224号。

A.P. 伯林斯基，俄罗斯犹太人，1896年9月16日生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克（Irkutsk），于1929年8月从哈尔滨来到上海，并在霞飞路807号开设了一家小型钟表修理及珠宝店。1934年，他在两名西班牙合伙人的资金援助下扩大了业务，并在霞飞路987号成立了“乌拉尔”（Ural）珠宝店。1936年6月26日，伯林斯基因收受赃物被法国警察罚款50元。他已在当地俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（签名）F. W. **〔此处转录不清〕**

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. .........
S.I, Special Branch. .........
REPORT
Date March 10, ......... 19 37.

Subject Communication dated February 3, 1937 from the Commissioner of
Police, Macao, concerning S.A.J. Vittenson and A.P. Berlinsky.

Made by D.S.I. Makaroff Forwarded by T. Byrne D.S.I

Solomon Aron Jacob Vittenson, Lithuanian Jew, was born
on December 15, 1882 at Kovno, Lithuania.

In 1919 he came to Shanghai from Harbin and for the
following two years was employed as a chief salesman with
Aron Fein's Haberdashery Store, at 45 North Szechuen Road.

In 1921 he proceeded to Vladivostok, Maritime Province,
and subsequently to Harbin, where he stayed for about five
years. Returning to Shanghai in 1926 he established his
present business known as the "Ideal" Haberdashery Store,
835 Avenue Joffre.

S.A.J. Vittenson is in possession of a Lithuanian passport
No.224 issued in 1921 by the Lithuanian Consul in Vladivostok.

Alexander Pavlovitch Berlinsky, Russian Jew, was born on
September 16, 1896 at Irkoutsk, Siberia.

In August 1929 he came to Shanghai from Harbin and
established a small watch repairing and jewellery store at
807 Avenue Joffre.

It is reported that in 1934 two Mal Alai players, namely
Chatto and Rafael, both Spanish citizens, became Berlinsky's
partners in his enterprise, following which he was able to
expand the business and removed his shop to a larger and
better premises at 787 Avenue Joffre, which at present is
known as the "Ural" Jewellery Store.

Berlinsky is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road.

On June 26, 1936 he was fined $50.00 by the French Police
for "Receiving Stolen Property".

Apart from the above nothing detrimental is known by this
office concerning these individuals either politically or
criminally.

D.C. (Special Branch).
W. MacRae
D.S.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 ____ 
特别科 S.I, ____ 
报告
日期 1937年3月10日。

事由：澳门警务处处长1937年2月3日来函，关于S.A.J. 维滕森和A.P. 伯林斯基。

由特别科督察长马卡罗夫（Makaroff）撰写，由特别科督察长T. 伯恩（Byrne）转呈

所罗门·阿伦·雅各布·维滕森，立陶宛犹太人，1882年12月15日生于立陶宛科夫诺。

1919年他从哈尔滨来到上海，在接下来的两年里，受雇于四川北路45号的阿伦·费恩（Aron Fein）服饰用品店，担任首席售货员。

1921年，他前往滨海省符拉迪沃斯托克，随后前往哈尔滨，在那里停留了约五年。1926年回到上海后，他建立了目前的生意，即位于霞飞路835号的“理想”服饰用品店。

S.A.J. 维滕森持有1921年由立陶宛驻符拉迪沃斯托克领事签发的立陶宛护照，号码为224号。

亚历山大·帕夫洛维奇·伯林斯基，俄罗斯犹太人，1896年9月16日生于西伯利亚伊尔库茨克（Irkoutsk）。

1929年8月，他从哈尔滨来到上海，并在霞飞路807号开设了一家小型钟表修理及珠宝店。

据报，1934年，两名名为查托（Chatto）和拉斐尔（Rafael）的马尼拉牌（Mal Alai）玩家，均为西班牙公民，成为伯林斯基企业的合伙人，此后他得以扩大业务，并将店铺迁至霞飞路787号一处更大、更好的 premises，该店目前称为“乌拉尔”珠宝店。

伯林斯基已在穆明路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。

1936年6月26日，他因“收受赃物”被法国警察罚款50.00元。

除上述情况外，本局在政治或刑事方面未掌握有关这些人的任何不利信息。

特别科副主任督察。
W. 麦克雷（MacRae）
特别科督察长。

Macau, February 3, 1937.

From Commissioner of Police
MACAU
Ref. no. 145

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I am writing to ask whether your Police Force
has any information regarding the two undermentioned
persons whose photographs are attached herewith:-

Solomon Aron Jacob Vitenson, married,
55 years of age, native of Kovna, Lithuania,
son of Jacob Vitenson and Deba Vitenson.

Alexander Pavlovich Berlinsky, married,
41 years of age, native of Russia, son of
Paul Berlinsky and Doba Berlinsky.

The two men came from Shanghai. Vitenson
used to reside at No.835 Avenue Joffre.

Your obedient servant,

(Signed) Rodrigo Brandao Guedes Pinto,
Commissioner of Police.

COLONIA DE MACAU
Administração do Concelho
Comissariado de Polícia
N.º 140
Referencia a ............ n.º ............
ASSUNTO:
Confidencial

Macau, 3 de Fevereiro de 1937.

Exmo. Snr.

Tornando-se conveniente conhecer os individuos abaixo mencionados, de que junto as fotografias, tenho a honra de rogar a V.Exa. se digne informar-me do que constar acêrca dos mesmos, o que antecipadamente agradeço:

Solomon Aron Jacob Vitenson, casado, de 55 anos de idade, natural de Kovna, Lituania, filho de Jacob vitenson e de Joba vitenson.

Alexander Pavlovich Berlinsky, casado, de 41 anos de idade, natural da Russia, filho de Paul Berlinsky e de Joba Berlinsky.

Informo V.Exa. que os referidos individuos vieram de Shanghai, e que o primeiro residia no prédio n.º 835 da Avenue Joffre.

Aproveito a oportunidade para reiterar a V.Exa. os protestos da minha maior consideração.

A bem da Nação.

Exmo. Senhor,

Comissário de Policia Municipal em Shanghai.

O Administrador do Concelno e
Comissário de Policia, intº,

Rodrigo Brandão Guedes Pinto,
Ten.

澳门，1937年2月3日。

尊敬的先生：

鉴于有必要了解下述人员的情况，随函附上他们的照片，本人荣幸地请求阁下惠予告知有关这些人的已知情况，对此预先表示感谢：

所罗门·阿伦·雅各布·维滕森，已婚，55岁，立陶宛科夫纳（Kovna）人，雅各布·维滕森和乔巴·维滕森（Joba vitenson）之子。

亚历山大·帕夫洛维奇·伯林斯基，已婚，41岁，俄罗斯人，保罗·伯林斯基和乔巴·伯林斯基（Joba Berlinsky）之子。

特此告知阁下，上述人员来自上海，其中第一人曾居住在霞飞路835号大楼。

借此机会，再次向阁下表达我最崇高的敬意。

为了国家利益。

尊敬的先生，

上海市政警务专员。

市政厅管理员兼

罗德里戈·布兰道·格德斯·平托（Rodrigo Brandão Guedes Pinto），
